Dr. Rakesh Maurya, an expert on qualitative methodologies, explains protocol coding method in qualitative data analysis. He currently works at the University of North Florida, U.S.A., and teaches qualitative research to doctoral students.

Introducing Protocol Coding in Qualitative Research, our latest video guide designed for researchers, students, and professionals seeking to deepen their understanding of qualitative analysis methods. Protocol Coding is a structured approach to analyzing data, focusing on sequences, procedures, and the systematic execution of actions within the research context. This method is invaluable for studies that examine processes, instructional methods, and any context where understanding the order and structure of events is crucial.

This comprehensive tutorial covers:

An overview of Protocol Coding and its importance in qualitative data analysis
A step-by-step guide on how to apply Protocol Coding to your qualitative research data
Techniques for identifying and categorizing sequences and procedures in your data
Practical examples and case studies demonstrating the application of Protocol Coding
Insights into how Protocol Coding can unveil patterns, efficiencies, and the rationale behind processes
Whether you are conducting educational research, process evaluations, or exploring complex workflows, this video will equip you with the analytical tools to apply Protocol Coding effectively. Gain insights into the intricacies of procedural data and enhance your research findings with our expert guidance.
